elements.description: The settings card of one connected service: a switch, an API key, the site address and a time zone, with a save bar.

properties.name: count
properties.description: Small number next to the name, e.g. synced orders

properties.name: meta
properties.description: Line under the name, e.g. when it was connected

properties.name: values
properties.description: The saved values. Edits collect in the save bar; fields that weren't edited follow new values right away

properties.name: siteHint
properties.description: Helper text under the address field

properties.name: timeZones
properties.default: [ "(GMT −08:00) Los Angeles", "(GMT −05:00) New York", "(GMT −03:00) São Paulo", "(GMT +00:00) London", "(GMT +01:00) Berlin", "(GMT +01:00) Amsterdam", "(GMT +01:00) Warsaw", "(GMT +02:00) Athens", "(GMT +04:00) Dubai", "(GMT +05:30) Mumbai", "(GMT +08:00) Singapore", "(GMT +09:00) Tokyo", "(GMT +10:00) Sydney", ]
properties.description: The time zones the picker offers, as labels like "(GMT +01:00) Berlin" – the first is the default

properties.name: generateKey
properties.description: Creates a key; without it a random `sk_demo_…` key is made up (and warns once, unless `demo` is set)

properties.name: saveValues
properties.description: Called with all values when Save is pressed

properties.name: demo
properties.description: Demo mode: keys are made up silently when generateKey is missing

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-values-change
events.description: The saved values changed: after a save, or when the switch flipped ({ values: IntegrationValues }); cancelable

props.name: name
props.description: The service's name, e.g. "Shopify"

props.name: logo
props.description: The service's logo, shown beside its name

props.name: count
props.description: Small number next to the name, e.g. synced orders

props.name: meta
props.description: Line under the name, e.g. when it was connected

props.name: values
props.description:
The saved values. Controlled when defined: the card shows them, edits collect in the save bar, and saved changes
(Save, the switch) are reported through onValuesChange. Fields that weren't edited follow new values right away

props.name: defaultValues
props.description:
Saved values when uncontrolled. Read again when they change (e.g. once they've loaded) – fields that weren't
edited follow

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Called with all values whenever the saved values change: after a save, or when the switch flips

props.name: siteHint
props.description: Helper text under the address field

props.name: timeZones
props.description: The time zones the picker offers, as labels like "(GMT +01:00) Berlin" – the first is the default

props.name: onGenerateKey
props.description:
Creates a key – return it, or a promise of it; a rejection shows an error and keeps the old key. Without it a
random `sk_demo_…` key is made up (and warns once, unless `demo` is set)

props.name: onSave
props.type: (values: IntegrationValues, options: { signal: AbortSignal }) => void | Promise<void>
props.description:
Called with all values when Save is pressed. A rejection keeps the changes unsaved and shows an error.
The signal aborts when the card unmounts

props.name: demo
props.description: Demo mode: keys are made up silently when onGenerateKey is missing. For galleries and prototypes

props.name: onToggle
props.type: (enabled: boolean, options: { signal: AbortSignal }) => void | Promise<unknown>
props.description:
Called when the switch flips. May return a promise: the switch shows that it's working and flips when it
resolves; a rejection leaves it as it was and shows an error
